examples.code:
# Build a self-contained A-over-B composite for experimenting with Merge.
background = nuke.createNode("CheckerBoard2")
background.setName("Merge_demo_background")
background.setXYpos(0, 0)

foreground = nuke.createNode("ColorWheel")
foreground.setName("Merge_demo_foreground")
foreground.setXYpos(-140, 0)

merge = nuke.createNode("Merge2")
merge.setName("Foreground_over_background")
merge.setXYpos(0, 120)
merge.setInput(0, foreground)  # A: foreground
merge.setInput(1, background)  # B: background

# Use the standard A-over-B operation and process RGBA.
merge["operation"].setValue("over")
merge["Achannels"].setValue("rgba")
merge["Bchannels"].setValue("rgba")
merge["output"].setValue("rgba")
merge["bbox"].setValue("union")

# Lower Mix to reveal how the A input contributes to the result.
merge["mix"].setValue(0.75)
